entries.decision: approve the precise current-scope regression update
entries.rationale: The before/after complete source retains all 22 case IDs. entries.decision: approve the new synthetic Chengdu browser regression
entries.rationale: The complete 169-line new helper runs 11 real Chromium browser cases over a fresh synthetic Chengdu scenario and a random-port local HTTP server. It checks surname-only unknown lead facts, proposal without fact/consent mutation, stored millimetre SVG coordinates and room names, point-row editing and owner signing denial, exact employee/skill labels plus stale skill clearing, budget-zero/service-area/appointment missingness, official reference links and fictional affiliation, injected read-error recovery, eight routes at 390 and 320 widths, and ledger integrity with zero model-completed seed tasks. Its non-TTY streams keep owner access unavailable; imported data, direct setup calls and evidence are expressly synthetic. Failure records, startup errors or cleanup errors make the command fail. Source hashes cover six listed artifacts after execution, not the complete Git tree or all dependencies. DEPTH-UI-10 allows generic Failed to load resource messages, so absence of all unexpected network errors is not proven. Actual formal CNB execution remains required.
